svg.title: Anaphase, Telophase and Cytokinesis
svg.desc: Anaphase has twelve daughter chromosomes, six moving to each pole with centromeres leading and arms trailing. Telophase has two emerging animal daughter cells joined at a cleavage furrow, with reforming envelopes, nucleoli and decondensing chromatin. Original unmeasured animal-cell schematics after lecture 06B source figures. Purple denotes chromosomes; yellow denotes microtubules and centrosomes. Counts of chromatin loops and spindle fibers are illustrative.
